name: Kensho
tagline: Kensho (acquired by S&P Global) is an AI analytics platform purpose-built for financial markets and macroeconomic research. Its NLP models extract structured data from earnings transcripts, SEC filings, and news feeds, and its event-study tools quantify how markets historically react to specific macro triggers. Quantitative analysts and investment researchers use Kensho to find signals that traditional data providers miss.
